item.title: Rama Vaidhyanathan’s Maalyada: Andal’s Sacred Garland, in Hyderabad, is a dance tribute to Andal’s timeless poetry and philosophy
item.description: Rama Vaidyanathan's dance production, Maalyada: Andal’s Sacred Garland, pays homage to the profound poetry and philosophy of the 9th-century poet-saint Andal. Through Bharatanatyam, Rama and her team explore Andal's timeless verses, emphasizing shared experiences of devotion and understanding. Influenced by Jeysunder D.'s book, the performance balances joy and depth, celebrating Andal's genius and empowering expression.

item.title: Anuvab Pal’s show in Hyderabad is a comedic take on our society with a dash of critique on the side
item.description: Anuvab Pal's comedy show in Hyderabad offers a humorous yet insightful critique of society, focusing on cultural habits, contradictions, and everyday absurdities. Known for his intelligent and clean comedy, Anuvab avoids shock value, instead opting for sharp observations that linger with audiences. His work often explores themes of class, privilege, and power, providing a thoughtful reflection on societal structures.
